title: HTTP Gateway
description: Manage reverse proxies, HTTP policies and explicit traffic interception.
name: 이름
listenHelp: Leave empty for interception only. Public listeners require source CIDRs. Forwarding to an original destination is available only on admitted intercepted streams.
keyFile: Private key file on the backend
debugLoggingHelp: 저장하고 활성화하면 요청 요약이 설정 → 로그에 표시됩니다. 메서드, 경로, 상태, 본문 바이트 수와 처리 시간이 포함됩니다. 쿼리 문자열, 헤더와 본문 내용은 기록하지 않습니다.
createRulesFirst: Create HTTP rules, then select them here.
priorityHelp: Lower numbers match first. Equal priorities use rule ID order. The first matching enabled rule wins.
selectRuleHelp: 편집할 규칙을 선택하거나 HTTP 규칙을 추가하세요.
selectPoolHelp: 편집할 백엔드 풀을 선택하세요. 풀을 추가하려면 풀이 지정되지 않은 Reverse proxy 작업을 선택하세요.
retries: Network retries for replayable idempotent requests (0–3)
mitmWarning: Installing and trusting this CA allows explicitly enabled HTTPS MITM to read decrypted HTTP traffic. Enable it only for traffic you are authorized to inspect. Installing the certificate does not enable interception by itself.
protocolLimits: ECH, certificate pinning, mutual TLS, non-HTTP TLS and HTTP/3 are outside MITM support. Exclude affected domains or choose passthrough. UDP/QUIC remains unchanged. A failed MITM handshake cannot fall back to passthrough.
interceptionHelp: Only explicitly selected TCP inbounds enter interception. TLS passthrough cannot match HTTP paths or headers. Generate a CA before enabling HTTPS MITM. 기존 라우팅 페이지에서 HTTP Gateway 작업 규칙을 만들고 이 Gateway를 선택하세요. 가로채기 설정은 해당 라우팅 규칙과 일치한 연결만 처리하도록 허용합니다.
filterHelp: Supported: ||example.com/ads/* and @@||example.com/ads/allowed. Domain rules and trailing anchors are supported. Options ($...), cosmetic rules (##), scriptlets and unanchored regex are rejected and counted.
empty: No gateways configured. Existing TCP and UDP forwarding continues unchanged.
connectionsLink: Open existing Connections and traffic monitoring
testerHelp: Tests the saved running snapshot. Save and activate edited rules first. Test inputs are not forwarded to any upstream. 가로채기 테스트에는 inbound ID를 입력하고 리버스 리스너는 비워 둡니다. 제한이 있으면 소스 IP와 프로세스도 입력하세요. 저장된 설정으로 테스트합니다. 선택한 Gateway만 테스트합니다. 앞선 Gateway 동작은 Routing 테스트에서 확인하세요.
requiresMitm: HTTPS request parsing requires termination or MITM
subject: Subject
rotationWarning: Replacing the CA changes its fingerprint and trust identity. Clients must trust the new certificate; old cached leaf certificates are discarded. The CA private key is never available through this API.
importHelp: Choose a signing CA certificate and matching PKCS#8 private key. Import replaces the local CA. The private key is sent only to the authenticated management API and is never returned. Protect the management connection with TLS.
installation: Install and trust the public certificate
installationHelp: Install only the public root certificate on clients you control. Check the SHA-256 fingerprint before trusting it. The application never installs system trust automatically.
installWindows: Windows: import the certificate into Trusted Root Certification Authorities for the intended user or computer.
installMac: macOS: import in Keychain Access, then explicitly trust it for SSL.
installLinux: Linux: use your distribution’s local CA directory and trust update command. Browsers may use a separate certificate store.
installMobile: Android / iOS: install a user CA or profile in system settings, then enable full trust where required. Many applications do not trust user-installed CAs.
upstreamInUse: 이 업스트림을 삭제하기 전에 Gateway 작업과 규칙에서 참조를 제거하세요.
unifiedDescription: Gateway별로 트래픽 소스, HTTP 정책, 필터 및 백엔드를 함께 구성합니다.
routeHandoffHelp: 이 Gateway로 보낼 트래픽과 Inbound 조건은 Routing에서 설정합니다. 여기서는 HTTP/TLS 처리를 설정합니다. HTTPS MITM에는 CA 신뢰와 명시적 도메인 허용이 필요합니다.
backendPoolHelp: HTTP 규칙이나 기본 작업에서 Reverse proxy를 선택하고 '새 백엔드 풀 만들기'를 선택한 뒤 아래에서 풀을 추가하세요. 해당 작업에만 연결되며 다른 작업은 변경되지 않습니다.
